d: “koee kahta nahin hai ki ‘goli mar do’. ordar milta hai ki pradarshan ko roko. kaise rokna hai, vo aap par hai.” ye kahna hai eeran ke suraksha tantr men intelijens ofisar aur elit fors ke kamandar rahe do purv adhikariyon ka, jo us tantr ka sath chhor chuke hain. DW ki investigetiv yunit ne in purv adhikariyon se barnar fons, enkripted aips aur kod vards se bat ki aur mahinon tak unki pahchan aur unke die dokyuments aur fotoz-vidiyoz ki partal ki.
